title: hostedapi-mini-workbench-screens-and-compact-snippets
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a compact, mobile-friendly "mini-workbench" screenshot pack and code snippet variants for the Hosted API getting-started flow. The goal is to provide a condensed onboarding visual that can be embedded in docs, emails, and in-product banners: 1) Compact model selector (single-line rows with tier badges and quick info), 2) Inline request builder with prompt templates and a streaming indicator, 3) Copyable code snippets for Python, Node, and cURL with small token estimates, 4) Function-calling toggle and structured JSON output preview, 5) Accessibility-ready color contrasts and keyboard focus states. Include both dark and light theme variants and a narrow-width layout for doc sidebars.
